headline: A 2021 law lets the Treasury Department mint and sell $1 coins marking 100 years since the Morgan and Peace dollars.
what_it_does: The law directs the Treasury Department to mint and issue $1 coins to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the end of Morgan dollar production and the start of Peace dollar production. Treasury may begin issuing the coins starting January 1, 2021. The coins must be sold for their face value plus the cost of designing and issuing them. Treasury may also sell them in bulk at a reasonable discount.

who_it_affects.how: People who want commemorative Morgan and Peace dollar coins can buy them from Treasury at face value plus design and issuing costs.

who_it_affects.group: Bulk buyers such as coin dealers
who_it_affects.how: Treasury may offer these coins in bulk at a reasonable discount, which could be available to larger purchasers.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted January 5, 2021, and the summary says Treasury may begin issuing the coins beginning January 1, 2021.
